description: This PHP file defines the class 'EmailsViewDeleteDraftEmail', which extends 'ViewAjax'. It handles AJAX requests to delete draft emails in the SuiteCRM email module. The class includes methods to process the request and generate JSON responses based on the email's status ('draft', 'save_error', or other).

classes.name: EmailsViewDeleteDraftEmail
classes.description: A class handling AJAX view for deleting draft emails within SuiteCRM's email module.
